title: Change Order Fee Forgiveness at Final Settlement — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
A Ridgeline Installation Services contract whose change orders stayed small has some or all of its change order administration fees forgiven at final settlement.

**Clause.** Change order fee forgiveness on the final settlement payment: the change order increase is every change order billed as a percentage of the contract price billed; when the increase is above 0 and below the small-change percentage of 5, the whole of the change order administration fees charged on the contract is forgiven; when the increase is at or above the small-change percentage and below the mid-change percentage of 10, the mid-change forgiveness share of 0.5 of those fees is forgiven; otherwise nothing is forgiven.

The forgiveness is the change order administration fees charged on the contract multiplied by the share forgiven, rounded to the cent, and it is deducted from the final settlement payment.

## Terms used

- **Every change order billed** is the total of the change order billing lines on the contract; a change order reduction posts as a credit and does not enter this figure.
- **Contract price billed** is the contract price on the contract billing line.
- **Change order administration fees** are the administration fee lines charged on the contract; with none charged there is nothing to forgive.

| Change order increase | Share forgiven |
|---|---|
| 0 (no change order billed) | none |
| above 0 and below 5 percent | the whole fee (1) |
| 5 percent up to, but not including, 10 percent | 0.5 |
| 10 percent or more | none |

## Boundary and worked figures (hypothetical contract price billed 10000.00, administration fees charged 75.00)

| Change orders billed | Increase | Forgiven |
|---|---|---|
| 499.00 | 4.99 percent | 75.00 |
| 500.00 | 5 percent | 37.50 |
| 999.00 | 9.99 percent | 37.50 |
| 1000.00 | 10 percent | 0.00 |
